title: Hyperlane on Terra Classic — Delivery Report & Payment Proposal
summary: Payment for the completed Hyperlane integration on Terra Classic approved in proposal #12200 (USD 12,000 budget). LUNC and USTC bridge between Terra Classic, Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain and Solana; Terra Classic contracts owned and administered by on-chain governance (#12229, #12230); synthetic side controlled by the validators' 4-of-6 multisigs (Safe on EVM, Squads on Solana); 6-validator set, threshold 4; officially registered with Hyperlane (hyperlane-registry PRs #1559 and #1687). Community Pool spend of 253,074,165.29 LUNC to terra14yvuxm40affmkt36m2ummvzvlka25u3ucurxjl. Full delivery report, contract inventory and links: https://github.com/terra-classic-hyperlane/docs/blob/main/PAYMENT-PROPOSAL.md
